topic: Day 149 — reel — Relationships that grow with you take a different kind of work, not less work
text:
Growing together
isn't [less] work.
It's different
work.
caption:
A relationship that keeps changing shape doesn't demand less effort than a static one. It demands another kind, and people mistake that for failure.

Follow for one of these a day.
